Tourists keep walking past this place on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Their loss.

Aigue-Marine French Bistro by Hidden Gem is serving real French bistro food on Phu Quoc for $15-30 a head. 4.7 stars across 332 reviews. That rating doesn't lie.

Not a beach bar. Not a resort buffet. Actual French cooking, one block from the main strip.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
